source_assessment.finding: The sole program source diff replaces unconditional canonical total-time printf with MPI_Allreduce of the local long total using MPI_LONG/MPI_MAX, followed by rank-0 printf. No algorithm, input, result vector, output helper, validation code, or result-output rank guard changed.

runSimulation synchronizes CUDA and gathers the full timestep onto every rank; computeDistances finishes its OpenMP loop before returning. Only then does main sum phase durations and perform the added collective. The new collective buffer is totalTime, which is used only for timing and its derived metric, with no data flow into state.distances or hashing.

All ranks receive the same -o option, and printResults is not rank-guarded in either revision. All ranks also print performance and internal-validation messages. print_results uses separate printf calls for marker, name, fields, samples, hash, and end marker, with no inter-rank serialization. Four ranks can interleave both RESULTS fields and surrounding diagnostics. Restricting only print_results would not by itself prevent other ranks' diagnostics contaminating a root block.

The added collective requires every rank to complete distance computation before continuing and may increase overlap of their subsequent printing. This is a plausible exposure mechanism, not proof that this edit alone caused the exact retained interleaving; scheduling and stdout forwarding are untagged/nondeterministic. The underlying output defect and the exact reason the comparator rejects THIS log are directly proven.
